title: Validate agent task snapshot, run count and active-task responses
recorded_defect: CLAUDE.md, API Compatibility: 'Endpoint responses consumed by UI logic must pass through a schema before returning.' packages/core/api/client.ts getAgentTaskSnapshot, getWorkspaceAgentRunCounts and getActiveTasksForIssue return unvalidated this.fetch(...) results although AgentTaskSchema and AgentTaskListSchema already exist in packages/core/api/schemas.ts.
trial_role: Trial 2, task 3. Reuse of an existing schema rather than writing one; tests whether the executor finds and reuses AgentTaskSchema instead of duplicating it.
objective:
packages/core/api/client.ts has three agent task projection methods that trust the server response without validation: getAgentTaskSnapshot (AgentTask[]), getWorkspaceAgentRunCounts (AgentRunCount[]) and getActiveTasksForIssue ({ tasks: AgentTask[] }). packages/core/api/schemas.ts already defines AgentTaskSchema and AgentTaskListSchema. The repository rule in CLAUDE.md (API Compatibility) requires endpoint responses consumed by UI logic to pass through a zod schema via parseWithFallback, with a malformed-response test.

Bring these three methods under that pattern, reusing existing schemas where they fit and adding only what is missing. Do not change any other method.

Write tests at exactly packages/core/api/agent-task-projection-schemas.test.ts that show each method returns the parsed value for a well-formed response and does not pass a malformed response through to the caller.
